name: Himekoi * Sucreine!
source:
Ryou entered a rather unusual private boarding school built in the middle of a forest. Even though Takaramori Gakuen had turned co-ed three years ago, there were not many boys possibly due to the school not being well-known and its long history as a girl’s school. He became the focus of attention from all the curious girls since he was the only boy in the class.

Tired from the sudden attention, he was taking a break during lunch in the courtyard when his classmate Chiyuri invited him to join her occult club (which was registered as the literature club). He didn’t have any club in mind, so he agreed to temporarily join as a trial member.

That night, they went to the old school building to investigate one of the seven mysteries in the school: the ‘spell of the large mirror’. It is said that if you touch the antique mirror in the hallway at midnight while strongly wishing for something, it will come true. As he was being hurried by Chiyuri, he wished to fall in love and carelessly tripped while touching the mirror.

When he came to, he found himself back in his own room. He thought nothing of it and headed to school, where he met a girl who he didn’t recognize, Mayuki. She was wearing a beautiful dress, but it matched the surroundings. Mayuki interacted with him like they had always been close friends, and while he felt a bit uncomfortable being suddenly so close to a girl, he was actually quite happy inside. When he arrived at the classroom, everyone wore pretty dresses and quickly became his friends. It was as if it was a dream.

The next day, Mayuki was nowhere to be seen and no one knew of her existence. He thought that it might have been caused by the spell and headed back to the old school building at midnight, but there was no change in the reflection. Thus, he returned home downcast and went to sleep.

However, he saw Mayuki again in his dreams. The magic mirror had created a dream world and he could meet her every night when he slept. So begins his dual life attending both school in the real world and the dream world.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
凉进入了一所建在森林深处、相当奇特的私立寄宿学校。宝森学园三年前改为男女同校，但由于名气不大、又有悠久的女子学校历史，男生仍然很少。他成了班上唯一的男生，所有好奇的女孩都把注意力集中在他身上。

不堪突如其来的关注，他午休时到中庭休息，同班同学千百合邀请他加入自己的灵异社（登记名称其实是文学社）。他没有想加入的社团，便同意暂时以试用成员身份参加。

当天晚上，他们来到旧校舍调查学校七大不可思议之一“巨大镜子的咒语”。据说午夜时触摸走廊里的古镜，并强烈许愿，愿望就会实现。千百合催促他时，他许愿自己坠入爱河，并在触摸镜子时不小心绊倒。

恢复意识后，他发现自己回到房间，没把这件事放在心上，照常去学校，却遇见一名不认识的女孩真雪。她穿着漂亮洋装，与周围环境十分相称。真雪像一直以来都是亲密朋友那样与他互动，虽然突然和女孩如此亲近让他有些不自在，内心却十分开心。来到教室后，所有人都穿着漂亮洋装，很快与他成为朋友，仿佛置身梦境。

第二天，真雪不见踪影，没人知道她存在。他猜想这可能是咒语造成的，于是午夜回到旧校舍，但镜中的景象没有变化。失落的他回家睡觉。

然而，他又在梦中见到了真雪。原来魔镜创造了梦境世界，他每晚入睡后都能在那里与她相遇。就这样，他开始了同时往返现实学校与梦境世界的双重生活。
